title: Vaporesso DOJO Blast Pod & Refill For 10K or 30K Device – Banana Ice
description: Please Note: Compatible with Vaporesso Dojo Blast 10K & 30K Kits Only Keep your Vaporesso Dojo Blast 10K device running with the Banana Ice Prefilled Pod & Refill Pack. Each pack includes a 2ml prefilled pod plus an 8ml refill container, together delivering up to 10,000 puffs of smooth, consistent flavour. Preloaded with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid, the pod and refill system offers a simple and reliable way to enjoy vaping with the Dojo Blast kit, supported by Vaporesso’s COREX 2.0 dual mesh coil and Smart Liq-Cycle saturation technology. Banana Ice combines the creamy sweetness of ripe Banana with a cool icy layer, creating a flavour that’s rich yet refreshing. Smooth fruit notes meet a chill finish, keeping the blend balanced and enjoyable for extended vaping. With transparent pods and a clean refill system, managing e-liquid levels is straightforward and fuss-free. Explore all 28 flavours from the Vaporesso Dojo Blast 10K collection here at Vapestore.
